issues.problem: The free Basic edition's limit is published, not unknown.
issues.suggestion: Set to "5,000 API calls/day; US-only data; attribution required."

issues.problem: The entry says the limit is unpublished, but FatSecret publishes a 5,000-calls-per-day limit for Basic.
issues.suggestion: Set to "Basic: 5,000 API calls/day; Premier tiers: unlimited API calls."

issues.problem: The Bearer credential is an OAuth access token obtained with the client credentials, not the API key itself.
issues.suggestion: Replace YOUR_API_KEY with YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN and mention the token request to https://oauth.fatsecret.com/connect/token.

issues.problem: This URL is an obsolete page about internally generated PHP code documentation, not the current REST/FHIR API documentation.
issues.suggestion: Use https://www.open-emr.org/wiki/index.php/OpenEMR_8.2.0_API or the linked rel-820 FHIR documentation.

issues.problem: The Authorization header requires an OAuth access token, while YOUR_API_KEY incorrectly implies a static API key.
The snippet largely uses the legacy quote schema. The current stable endpoint documents changePercentage, not changesPercentage, and its documented field set differs from this legacy-style response.
issues.suggestion: Regenerate the snippet from /stable/quote and use changePercentage with the current stable response fields.

issues.problem: The entry mixes the deprecated v3 Server API authentication with the current v4 interface. V4 uses Authorization: Bearer SECRET_API_KEY; the old Auth-API-Key header and api_key query parameter belong to v3.
issues.suggestion: Describe current v4 server authentication as "secret API key via Authorization: Bearer" and document public client keys separately.

issues.problem: The current Free plan allows up to 1,000 web/iOS API calls per month, not 20,000.
issues.suggestion: Set to "1,000 web/iOS API calls per month; up to 500,000 Android calls per month; 14-day Pro Plus trial included."

issues.problem: Fingerprint publishes a 5-requests-per-second API rate limit for Free and Pro Plus, so "not published" is incorrect.
issues.suggestion: Set to "5 requests/second for Free and Pro Plus; custom for Enterprise."

issues.problem: The curl and nested products response use the deprecated v3 GET /events/{request_id} interface. Current v4 uses /v4/events/{event_id}, Bearer authentication, snake_case names, and a flatter response.
issues.suggestion: Use "curl -s https://api.fpjs.io/v4/events/EVENT_ID -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_API_KEY'" and replace the response with the current v4 schema.

issues.problem: The current Free plan provides 1,000 credits every month; the entry's approximately 500-credit and possibly non-renewing description is outdated.
issues.suggestion: Set to "1,000 credits/month, 2 concurrent browsers, and Free-plan endpoint rate limits."

issues.problem: Firecrawl now publishes exact per-plan, per-endpoint request-per-minute and concurrency limits.
issues.suggestion: Replace this with the published table; for example, Free currently allows 10 RPM for scrape/map/search, 2 RPM for crawl/agent, and 2 concurrent browsers.

issues.problem: The current lineup also includes a Scale plan, which the stated tier list omits.
issues.suggestion: List Hobby, Standard, Growth, Scale, and Enterprise, using the current pricing page for prices and credits.

issues.problem: Fireworks offers new users $1 in introductory credits, but does not provide an ongoing free tier for inference.
issues.suggestion: Set free_tier to false and describe the $1 new-user credit as a trial credit.

issues.problem: Rate limits are published. Accounts without a payment method or credits are limited to 10 RPM, while active funded accounts have an account-wide ceiling of 6,000 RPM, alongside serverless token limits.
issues.suggestion: Replace "not published" with the documented account and serverless quota behavior.

issues.problem: The selected llama-v3p1-8b-instruct model is currently marked as not supporting serverless inference, so this direct chat-completions request will not work unless the user creates an on-demand deployment.
issues.suggestion: Use a currently supported serverless model such as accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1, or address a user-created deployment instead.

issues.problem: The quoted approximately $10–80 range and implication that HTTPS is a paid-only feature are outdated. The current public plans are Basic $14.99/month, Professional $59.99/month, Professional Plus $99.99/month, and Custom; SSL is listed on the Free plan.
issues.suggestion: Update the tier names, prices, and features from the current pricing page and remove HTTPS from the paid-only benefits.

issues.problem: The timestamp and date are internally inconsistent: Unix timestamp 1519296206 is from February 2018, not 2024-01-15.
issues.suggestion: Use a timestamp matching 2024-01-15, or change the date and rates to a genuine response generated at timestamp 1519296206.

issues.problem: The Personal tier has no monthly minimum and includes up to $5 of AeroAPI usage free each month, so marking free_tier false misses the available recurring free allowance.
issues.suggestion: Set free_tier to true with limits such as "$5 of per-query usage free per month on Personal ($10 for eligible ADS-B feeders); charges apply after the allowance; 10 result sets/minute."
